title: bharatSetu: a 1M x 22 bridge for indic translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15705v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: India's Eighth Schedule recognises 22 languages, yet parallel data is uneven across them, and many language pairs, especially among lower-resource languages such as Bodo, Dogri, Santali and Kashmiri, lack direct bitext. We present BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M, a row-aligned table of 984,764 English sentences, each paired with machine translations into all 22 scheduled languages (21,664,808 Indic cells), generated with the sarvamai/sarvam-translate model family. Because every Indic cell in a row translates the same English sentence, any two columns form a translation pair: 462 directed Indic-to-Indic pairs, or 506 including English, without direct bitext. We call these pivot-derived pairs and propose a confidence layer that lets users choose how strictly each pair is connected. The corpus is machine-generated and not human-verified; quality is expected to vary by language, domain and sentence style, and pivot-derived pairs can inherit errors

translated_title: BharatSetu：面向印度语言翻译的100万×22种语言桥梁
translated_abstract: 印度宪法第八附表承认22种语言，但这些语言之间的平行数据分布不均，许多语言对——尤其是博多语、多格拉语、桑塔利语和克什米尔语等低资源语言之间——缺乏直接的平行文本。我们推出了BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M，这是一个行对齐的表格，包含984,764个英文句子，每个句子都配有全部22种宪法承认语言的机器翻译（共21,664,808个印度语言单元格），由sarvamai/sarvam-translate模型家族生成。由于同一行中的每个印度语言单元格都翻译的是同一个英文句子，任意两列即可构成一个翻译对：462个有向的印度语言间翻译对，若包含英文则为506个，而无需直接的平行文本。我们将这类翻译对称为“枢轴衍生对”，并提出一种置信度层，让用户可以自行选择每个翻译对之间连接的严格程度。需要说明的是，该语料库为机器生成且未经人工验证，其质量预期会因语言、领域和句子风格而有所差异，枢轴衍生对也可能继承翻译错误。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个以英语为枢轴的百万级22语平行语料库，使得任意两种印度语言（包括缺乏直接平行文本的低资源语言组合）都能形成翻译对，并提供了可调节严格程度的置信度机制。
en_tdlr: BharatSetu provides a 1M x 22 English-pivot parallel corpus that forms 462+ Indic-to-Indic translation pairs, enabling translation between low-resource Indian languages that lack direct bitext, with a confidence layer for adjustable pair strictness.
